headline: Satin Creditcare subsidiary SGAL invests ₹5 crore in Indic Wisdom
summary: Satin Growth Alternatives Limited, a subsidiary of Satin Creditcare Network Limited, has made its first investment of ₹5 crore in Indic Wisdom. The capital, structured as NCDs and CCPS, will fund manufacturing scale-up and distribution expansion.

headline: Kec International wins Rs 1303 crore order from multiple clients
summary: Confirmed work order for T&D and cables across India, Middle East, and Americas. Adds to backlog covering 1.76 quarters of revenue. Order inflow stable after Q1FY27 surge.

headline: Info Edge appoints Himanshu Agarwal as CFO
summary: Info Edge (India) Ltd appoints Himanshu Agarwal as CFO and Additional Director, replacing interim CFO Ambarish Raghuvanshi. Naresh Chand Gupta joins as Independent Director.

headline: Poojaa Precision hosts investor meet on Sep 17
summary: Poojaa Precision Engg. Ltd will host an investor meeting on September 17, 2026, in Pune, Chakan, and Mumbai. The session is open to investors via in-person or virtual modes.

headline: Supra Pacific Financial to issue ₹50 crore NCDs
summary: Supra Pacific Financial Services Ltd schedules board meeting on September 17, 2026, to approve issuance of secured, unrated NCDs worth ₹50 crore via private placement.
